chapter_seo_title: Li Huowang Steals Jade Pendant in Hallucination Chapter 3
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang discovers that objects from his hallucination can cross into reality. Determined to exploit this, he steals a jade pendant—only to stumble into a mass escape plot.
og_title: Li Huowang Discovers a Treasure Trove in His Hallucination
og_description: When a piece of candy from the cave becomes real, Li Huowang realizes his hallucination may be a goldmine. But stealing a jade pendant leads him into a conspiracy of escape.
twitter_description: He wanted wealth. He got caught in a runaway plot.
